ops.body:
yasyf-home pre-repair snapshot (2026-07-25, read-only) — recipe deltas for the repair lane:

1. **cc-pool daemon is DOWN entirely, not just its socket**: zero cc-pool processes, `~/.cc-pool/daemon.log` ends `daemon stopped` 2026-07-22 04:42, `status.json` equally stale, `/Users/yasyf/.cc-pool/sync.sock` absent — and **no launchd job for cc-pool exists on this host at all**. Repair must install/enable the daemon as a supervised service (not just brew upgrade + hope), then confirm sync.sock exists and accepts.
2. **Pre-stop unhealth to watch for post-restart**: daemon.log shows `oauth usage failed: HTTP 401` for several accounts and `credential CAS worker … lstat …/accounts/acct-11: no such file or directory` before it went silent. If 401s persist after upgrade+restart, that's a credential problem needing the user — report, don't churn.
3. **Verification target correction**: the literal "acct-18 content catch-up: context deadline exceeded" string appears 0 times in serve/reconcile logs (newest `acct-18` mention 07-21, newest `context deadline exceeded` 07-19). The LIVE symptoms to drive to zero instead: `handshake failed` in serve.log (~every 40s, `manifest=reposync`, 1065 total) and reconcile's `dial unix /Users/yasyf/.cc-pool/sync.sock: connect: no such file or directory`.
4. **Stale versions confirmed**: synckitd 0.23.0 (vs 0.35.x current), cc-pool 0.63.2, cc-notes 0.39.2, reposync 0.16.0, fusekit-holder 1.5.0 (formula name is `fusekit-holder`, not `fusekit`). reposync IS brew-installed here — upgrade it too. captain-hook/cc-orchestrate/cc-interact have no brew/launchd footprint on this host (leave as-is).
5. Oddities, report-only: `cookiesync: unknown command "rpc-serve"` skew line in serve.log; a `com.apple.Virtualization.VirtualMachine.xpc` at 165% CPU for ~21h (possibly intentional — OrbStack/Tart present; sanity-check with user, do not kill); fusekit-holder loaded (×2) with zero active fuse mounts.

Machine caffeinated until ~03:30 UTC. Snapshot was read-only; nothing changed.
